header: Next-Gen SIEM events, alerts, and incidents
content:
In Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, detections and incidents show activity in your environment. Individual events that are part of these detections and incidents are shown
in Advanced Event Search in the repo xdr_indicatorsrepo.
This type of event contains metadata about the detection or incident. However, this metadata is intended for internal CrowdStrike use, and you may see other
items in this repo that are not documented here.
Important: This metadata is subject to change or deprecation. We recommend you do not rely on this data for business processes or decisions.
Sample items in this repo:
Ngsiem.alert.id: ID of a Next-Gen SIEM detection referencing this indicator
Ngsiem.detection.id: ID of a Next-Gen SIEM incident referencing this indicator. All supporting events tied to an incident share the same value for this
field.
Ngsiem.event.data_domain: Associated data domain of this indicator
Ngsiem.event.id: ID of an associated Next-Gen SIEM event for this indicator
Ngsiem.event.product: Associated product for this indicator (deprecated, use Ngsiem.indicator.source_product)
Ngsiem.event.vendor: Associated vendor for this indicator (deprecated, use Ngsiem.indicator.source_vendor)
Ngsiem.indicator.display_name: Display name of this indicator
Ngsiem.indicator.id: ID of this indicator. All supporting events tied to an indicator share the same value for this field.

Ngsiem.parent.incident.id: ID of a parent incident for this indicator
